nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the current contract owner, set to msg.sender at deployment.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer.
EURO.symbol public string token symbol ('EURO').
EURO.name public string token name ('open euro').
EURO.decimals public uint8 token decimals (2).
EURO._totalSupply total token supply minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
EURO.balances mapping(address=>uint) holding every account token balance.
EURO.allowed nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) holding ERC20 allowances.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): checked addition with require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): checked subtraction with require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): checked multiplication with division-based overflow check.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): checked division with require(b > 0).
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender, granting full owner privileges to the deployer.
Owned.onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) access-control gate.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner, stores a pending newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, then transfers ownership and clears newOwner.
EURO constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints _totalSupply to a hardcoded address and emits Transfer.
EURO.totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] (internal subtraction, no SafeMath).
EURO.balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner].
EURO.transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender and credits 'to' using SafeMath.
EURO.approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no double-spend protection.
EURO.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits 'to'.
EURO.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
EURO.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval (external call).
EURO fallback function () public payable: unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH.
EURO.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens): onlyOwner, performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits and allowance ownership.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an arbitrary contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary, owner-supplied contract.
Unchecked uint subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] compiled with Solidity <0.8 (no SafeMath in this path).

edges.reason: Deployer (msg.sender) becomes owner in the Owned constructor, granting all onlyOwner privileges.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with the stored owner to gate privileged functions.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller directly controls the source account.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller as the allowance owner.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender], the caller identity selects the allowance slot.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as the source of allowance and as an argument to the external call.
The spender contract whose receiveApproval is invoked is chosen by msg.sender, letting it re-enter the token.
Caller-supplied spender address becomes the target of the receiveApproval external call.
Caller-supplied bytes data is forwarded unchanged into the external call payload.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable for its require check.
Only the owner may pass the onlyOwner gate before transferOwnership executes.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner, restricting the external call to the owner.
Caller-supplied _newOwner is written into newOwner without a zero-address check.
transferOwnership stores the pending owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads and validates the pending newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner, changing who controls privileged functions.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after the ownership handover.
EURO constructor sets the symbol string.
EURO constructor sets the name string.
EURO constructor sets decimals.
EURO constructor assigns the fixed _totalSupply.
EURO constructor mints the whole supply into balances of a hardcoded address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
totalSupply performs an unchecked uint subtraction with no SafeMath guard.
Caller-supplied tokenOwner selects the balance mapping slot returned by balanceOf.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
Recipient address parameter is written into balances in transfer.
Amount parameter drives the debit/credit arithmetic in transfer.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
Spender parameter keys the allowance mapping written by approve.
Amount parameter becomes the raw allowance value in approve.
approve writes the allowed mapping without any current-allowance check.
'from' parameter selects the balance and allowance slot debited by transferFrom.
'to' parameter selects the balance slot credited by transferFrom.
Amount parameter drives all arithmetic in transferFrom.
transferFrom updates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls safeSub for the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient credit.
tokenOwner parameter selects the outer allowance mapping key.
spender parameter selects the inner allowance mapping key.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
tokens parameter is stored as allowance and forwarded to the external call.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the spender contract, allowing reentrancy after state update (Effect-Interaction pattern).
tokenAddress parameter determines the target of the external call.
tokens parameter is forwarded as the transfer amount.
transferAnyERC20Token performs a callback-style external call to an arbitrary token contract supplied by the owner.
transferAnyERC20Token passes the owner address as the recipient of the recovered tokens.
